playstyle: Four Health-4 Orruk brutes with Move 3 and 1-shield saves, Ironskull's Boyz are sturdy brawlers who must fight as a pack. Their engine is surrounding enemies: attacking a Flanked or Surrounded target Inspires the attacker and all adjacent fighters, so isolation means weakness. Gurzag delivers brutal 3-damage strikes, Hakka sprays 4 dice and staggers on crits, and a free round-start push keeps the mob pressing toward enemy leaders. Victory comes from coordinated aggression — engulf a target, Inspire the cluster, and grind opponents down.
